_doc: Battle art sources. src = the generated still (facing right) that becomes frame 0; canvas = the animation canvas it is padded onto (feet `foot` px above the bottom, body shifted `dx` px from centre); prompts drive animate_image_pixminimax; strike = attack frame where the blow lands or the shot leaves; shot = where a projectile starts, in canvas px. Paths are relative to games/inkheroes/dev/. face = the centre of the unit's face in its idle frame (canvas px), for the 24 x 24 turn-order portrait.

spearman.name: Hoplite
spearman.subject: an ancient greek hoplite with bronze helmet, round bronze shield and spear
spearman.attack: spear thrust attack: draws the spear back, lunges forward thrusting the spear hard to the right, then recovers to the starting pose; feet stay in place

bowman.name: Slinger
bowman.subject: an ancient greek slinger in a white tunic swinging a leather sling
bowman.attack: slinging attack: whirls the sling overhead twice and releases the stone forward to the right with a snap of the arm, then recovers; feet stay in place

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.subject: a griffin with an eagle head, brown wings and a lion body
griffin.walk: flying in place loop: big slow wing beats, body bobs up and down a little, legs tucked, ends back at the starting pose
griffin.attack: pounce attack: rears up, beats its wings once and lunges forward to the right with beak and talons, then settles back to the starting pose

swordsman.name: Minotaur
swordsman.subject: a huge bull-headed minotaur with a double-headed labrys axe
swordsman.attack: axe chop attack: raises the double axe high over the horns and brings it down hard in front to the right, then lifts it back to the starting pose; hooves stay in place

monk.name: Centaur
monk.subject: a centaur archer: horse body with a bearded man's torso, drawing a bow
monk.attack: archery attack: draws the bowstring back to the cheek, holds, releases the arrow to the right, the bow snaps forward, then reaches for a new arrow and returns to the starting pose; hooves stay in place

lancer.name: Companion
lancer.subject: a greek companion cavalryman with a long lance on a white-grey warhorse
lancer.walk: galloping in place loop: the horse gallops with legs reaching and gathering, the rider rocks with the stride, stays in the same spot, ends back at the starting pose
lancer.attack: lance charge attack: the horse surges forward, the rider drives the long lance hard to the right, then the horse settles back to the starting pose

seraph.name: Titan
seraph.subject: a colossal golden-armoured titan holding a crackling lightning bolt
seraph.walk: slow heavy striding in place loop: huge legs lift and plant, cloak sways, stays in the same spot, ends back at the starting pose
seraph.attack: lightning strike attack: raises the lightning bolt high, crackling brighter, then hurls it down and forward to the right with a flash, then returns to the starting pose; feet stay planted

goblin.name: Satyr
goblin.subject: a satyr with goat legs, small horns, a short spear and a small shield
goblin.attack: quick spear jab attack: hops forward on goat legs and jabs the short spear to the right, then skips back to the starting pose

skeleton.name: Spartoi
skeleton.subject: a skeleton warrior with a bronze crested helmet, round shield and short sword
skeleton.attack: sword slash attack: raises the short sword and slashes forward to the right with a rattle of bones, then recovers to the starting pose; feet stay in place

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.subject: a snarling grey wolf
wolf.walk: trotting in place loop: four legs trot in rhythm, head low, tail streams, stays in the same spot, ends back at the starting pose
wolf.attack: bite attack: crouches, leaps forward to the right with jaws snapping, then lands back in the starting pose

bandit.name: Brigand
bandit.subject: a hooded greek brigand with a curved sword and a dagger
bandit.attack: sneak attack: darts forward to the right and slashes with the curved sword then stabs with the dagger, then springs back to the starting pose

ogre.name: Cyclops
ogre.subject: a one-eyed grey cyclops giant holding a boulder over his head
ogre.attack: boulder smash attack: lifts the boulder higher, then slams it down in front to the right, then picks it back up into the starting pose; feet stay planted

player.name: Strategos
player.subject: a greek general in a gilded bronze helmet with a blue crest on a black warhorse
player.walk: galloping in place loop: the horse gallops, the rider sways with the stride, stays in the same spot, ends back at the starting pose
player.attack: spell casting: the rider raises the sword to the sky, it flashes with golden light, then lowers it to the starting pose; the horse stays in place

defaults.idle: idle breathing loop: stands in place, chest rises and falls gently, weapon bobs slightly, feet stay planted, ends back at the starting pose
defaults.walk: walking in place loop: steps with legs alternating, body stays in the same spot, weapon held ready, ends back at the starting pose
